# Oakbridge Publishing

> Independent scholarly press (est. 2017, New Delhi). Publishes authoritative law, tax, business and academic titles, reference works, and children's and test-prep books, and runs events and professional training.

Categories: Law, Taxation, Business & Management, Academic, Professional & STEM, Test Prep, Children, General & Reference.

## Key pages

- [Bookstore](https://www.oakbridge.in/books): the full catalogue, filterable by category
- [eBooks](https://www.oakbridge.in/ebooks): titles available as eBooks
- [Authors](https://www.oakbridge.in/authors): the scholars and practitioners who write for Oakbridge
- [What We Do](https://www.oakbridge.in/what-we-do): publishing, events, academy and digital solutions
- [Events](https://www.oakbridge.in/events): conferences, launches and summits
- [Academy](https://www.oakbridge.in/academy): professional training programmes
- [Gifting](https://www.oakbridge.in/gifting): corporate and occasion book hampers
- [Submissions](https://www.oakbridge.in/submissions): how to submit a manuscript
- [About](https://www.oakbridge.in/about): the press and its team
- [Contact](https://www.oakbridge.in/contact): enquiries and bulk orders
